messages:
alex.g: Morning team! I'm Alex (new PM on Atlanta mobile). I can't see the staging console tenant for our project 'atlanta-mobile' — opening /console/tenants/atlanta-mobile gives a 403. Need to toggle a feature flag for a demo tomorrow, who owns tenant role mapping?

onboard-bot: Welcome to Redwood Inference, Alex! :wave: If you haven't yet, follow the New Hire checklist: https://intranet.redwood/collab/onboarding and request infra access in #infra-access so we can route it.

maria.dev: hey alex, welcome! cc @sam.infra — i think you're in prod-readonly but not staging-admin. Sam, can you check group membership and add alex to staging-admin-ops?

sam.infra: on it. Alex — what's your GitHub handle so I can add you to the Okta group?
alex.g: github: alex-garcia. Also, when i try the FF UI the toggles show "insufficient permissions" even though console lists me with "feature_flags:list". Screenshot says: Error: authorization failed (403).

maria.dev: that sounds like missing toggle scope. listing flags vs toggling flags are separate perms (featureflag:list vs featureflag:toggle). Sam should be able to add the toggle scope or a staging-admin role.

sam.infra: added alex-garcia to staging-admin-ops (Okta group). Give it a couple mins to propagate. Try logging out and back in if it still fails.
alex.g: tried after 5 mins, still 403. Full error from browser console: ```403 Forbidden: User not in tenant membership. GET /api/v1/tenants/atlanta-mobile/flags```

priya.sre: quick check — are you in the right org? We have multiple orgs in the console, top-right dropdown. If you're in a personal or partner org the tenant membership won't apply.
alex.g: good catch — i was on my personal org. switched to rw-inference and now I can see the flags :tada:

alex.g: one more question: who owns the production flag for `atlanta-experiments`? don't want to accidentally flip prod during the demo.
maria.dev: prod flag owner is product-eng (owner: @oliver). @oliver can confirm the prod access model for this flag.
oliver: confirmed — do NOT toggle prod for demo. i'll create a read-only prod-flag role for alex and add a note on the flag. if you need to test on prod safely, use canary with the CLI: `redwood-cli rollout --canary=1% --flag=atlanta-experiments` (you need canary-release role).
alex.g: thanks! final thing — where's the link to create service account keys for staging to run SDK tests? I didn't find it in the console nav.
sam.infra: service accounts are under Settings -> Service Accounts (left nav). If you need a token for CI i can create one and put it in vault. use name `ci-alexg-atlanta` and i will scope it to staging and embed perms.
maria.dev: welcome aboard again :wave: if you want i can do a 30m walkthrough of the console + FF flow right now.
alex.g: would love that, pls schedule when you have a slot. thanks everyone for the quick help!
